title: This month was really for the Off Broadway plays and the guilty pleas...
transcript: We are a week into June, which means it is time for a fashionably late may theatre recap. There are so many this month I can't even hold them all up. A master class in the art of listening. Missed opportunity to just make it a thrupple Tony winner Jodie Comer. I love spooky and I love getting to figure out a show on my own. Hot take not as outdated as I thought it was going to be. Wildly relatable. Only theater is my LeBron James. Better up close, but still missing something. Well crafted. But why? A peek behind the curtain do I love lames again? I want to see more of this story. They did, in fact, entertain me. This was such a cool theater space. Definitely out of this world. An absolute pleasant surprise. New favorite Orpheus Unlocked, part one of a cycle I can't wait to see the rest of. Goodbye, Goodbye, Goodbye! You were bigger than the whole sky, stronger than yesterday. In DC, Laughter is, in fact, the best medicine.
